title: Worker skills: subtasks in board show, PR recorded at once, codegraph, grep docs, history line before the PR
notes:
From the retro over the 10 worker sessions for #325-#333 (2026-11-18).
1. work-card-skill.ts:32-34 says a card's subtasks are shown by list; neither list nor show prints a parent, so all 5 implementers grepped for nothing. Make board show print a Subtasks block (id, column, title) and point the skill at show only.
2. Right after gh pr create, the skill runs board set <id> --pull-request <n>, so board review works at once (main was refused 'has no pull request ... yet' on #329).
3. When the project folder has .codegraph/, the skill says to run codegraph explore from there before reading files (workers cat'd whole files: 207k chars across 5; two confirmed .codegraph existed and still didn't use it).
4. Docs rule (CLAUDE.md docs paragraph, adopt-docs-skill.ts, and the work-card skill): to update a feature's docs, grep the README for what changed and read a decision only by its id, never cat the whole README/decisions (137k chars read across 5 workers; docs/board/README.md is 32.7k).
5. The history line is written in the card's commit before the PR is opened, without the PR number (4 of 5 workers made a second commit+push+CI run to add '#<n>'). Change the history format in adopt-docs-skill.ts (~line 175) and docs/README.md preamble to match; skills-decision-2 applies.
Docs: docs/skills, docs/board.

comments.body: One more item: the review prompt (src/main/ship/review.ts) says pr land's 'merged <n> at <sha>' line is the merge, so no gh pr view afterwards (workers ran it 3 times after a land).

Item 2 (run board set <id> --pull-request <n> right after gh pr create) is left out of this PR. It contradicts board-decision-6 ('An agent records no pull request') and BOARD_INSTRUCTIONS, which tell every worker not to record one. It would also not fix the refusal: board set from a worktree writes the project's board on origin, and finishedIn in src/main/ship/review-flow.ts ignores a project-board number on a card before Review (it is treated as the old closed PR), while the worktree's own board file never gets the number. So board review would still say 'has no pull request ... yet' until card.follow runs. A fix that works: when review() finds no pull request, run card.follow for that card (ask gh now) and look again before refusing. That needs its own card.
